patterns.what_worked: The generated API docs made the distinction explicit: UnitPower/UnitPowerMax are secret on Forever/Live, while StatusBar:SetValue/SetMinMaxValues accept secret bar values. The show gate was the only comparison. The achievement gate was a clean Retail-only predicate plus a render guard.
patterns.what_was_hard: Keeping the non-secret power path byte-identical while adding a secret branch, and proving the achievement row is absent for the right reason rather than because the render path was not reached.
patterns.skill_gap: No in-game feedback loop; the operator's Forever and Classic observations are the final acceptance.

escalation.recommendation: In-game pass: power bar on Forever (restricted unit) and one Classic client; achievement toggle disabled on Forever and enabled on Retail; no achievement row on Forever even with a saved true value. The disabled-dropdown body-click remains a recorded follow-up.
